values.binNote: No bin row corresponds to this timing value; ZiggsW.KnockbackSpeed/Distance/Gravity describe the knockback's physics but not an explicit duration in seconds, so this is wiki-only.

mechanics.claim: The ability is cast in two parts: an initial location-targeted throw, then a recast (or automatic recast after the duration) that detonates it for damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds ... ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

mechanics.claim: The explosion deals area damage to champions but raw (non-mitigated?) damage to turrets, relevant only in a turret context not a dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: Deals {{tip|area damage}} to non-turrets and {{tip|raw damage}} to turrets.

mechanics.claim: The explosion executes enemy turrets below the health threshold, which is not applicable to a champion target dummy.
mechanics.quote: The explosion also {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executes}}|magic}} enemy {{tip|turrets}} within that are below a {{as|'''maximum''' health}} threshold.

mechanics.claim: If the explosion hits Ziggs himself he dashes away; this is mobility, not damage or survival relevant.
mechanics.quote: If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} up to 825 units away from the center.
